b2d3e985b344df72b5d6c8e5b13134cd720cfaa9.summary: This is a Chinese-language forum post sharing a Windows credential-dumping utility, GetPwd_K8, described as built on the open-source mimikatz tool. It says the utility recovers plaintext logon passwords on Windows XP through Windows 7 and Server 2008, and it lists four builds with file sizes and hashes. The post says the builds are meant to help with antivirus evasion. The text is a tool-distribution post, not a threat analysis report, so no facts are recorded.
